questions.question: Which among the given classes provides types of rounding functions?
Which of these methods is a rounding function of Math class?
questions.explanation: Round() rounds up a variable to nearest integer.

questions.question: Which of these classes contains only floating point functions?
questions.explanation: Math class contains all the floating point functions that are used for general purpose mathematics methods. Example : sin(), cos(), exp(), sqrt() etc.

questions.question: Which of these method returns a smallest whole number greater than or equal to variable X?
questions.explanation: Ciel(double X) returns the smallest whole number greater than or equal to variable X.

questions.question: Which of these methods return a largest whole number less than or equal to variable X?
questions.explanation:
double Floor(double X) returns a largest whole number less than or equal to variable X.
